questions.questionMarkup: Which of the following pairs of type of precipitation and its cause is incorrect?
questions.questionText: Which of the following pairs of type of precipitation and its cause is incorrect?

options.html: Frontal precipitation: Occurs due to conflict of two air masses with different temperatures and densities.
options.text: Frontal precipitation: Occurs due to conflict of two air masses with different temperatures and densities.

options.html: Convective precipitation: Occurs when warm air descends rapidly, compresses and cools to form clouds.
options.text: Convective precipitation: Occurs when warm air descends rapidly, compresses and cools to form clouds.

options.html: Orographic precipitation: Occurs when moist air ascends a mountain slope, cools adiabatically, and gives rainfall on the windward side.
options.text: Orographic precipitation: Occurs when moist air ascends a mountain slope, cools adiabatically, and gives rainfall on the windward side.

options.html: Cyclonic precipitation: Occurs due to lifting of air masses into a low pressure zone.
options.text: Cyclonic precipitation: Occurs due to lifting of air masses into a low pressure zone.

questions.explanationHtml:
(b)
Convective rainfall is due to rising warm air.
